Round-by-round data from this 30-node scale-free network across 30 rounds shows that members who selected cooperation in every round had an average per-round payoff of 0.79. Members who selected defection in 3 or more rounds had an average per-round payoff of 0.41. The 0.38 payoff difference was consistent across the 30-round observation window.

Across 30 rounds in this network, members who selected cooperation in 25 or more rounds maintained an average cooperation-streak of 26.4 rounds. Members who selected defection in 5 or more rounds maintained an average cooperation-streak of 4.7 rounds. The majority of members (22 of 30) ended the observation window in the high-cooperation-streak category.
